audience: finance and IT teams that track SaaS subscriptions and their spend in Cledara

useCases.title: See which SaaS applications are active and when they renew
useCases.text: List the applications in the workspace with status, budget, owner, teams and balance. Read the next renewal or payment date of each one.

useCases.title: Total the debits for a period
useCases.text: List the transactions of a period. Negative amounts are debits. Filter by application and page through the results with the offset.

useCases.title: Get the invoice for a transaction
useCases.text: Find transactions that have an invoice. Get a download link for the invoice. The link is valid for 5 minutes.

useCases.title: Compare each application budget with its spend
useCases.text: Read the budget and balance of each application. Then list its transactions for the period to see the spend.
